questions.concept: Agent thread storage includes tool invocations and results
questions.context:
Convex 1.41.0 and Agent 0.6.4. A mounted Agent has a lookupInventory tool that reads the products table, default storage, and a three-step limit. A deterministic local model requests lookupInventory("Blue Widget") on its first step and produces "done" after the tool result. Two actions use the same thread: stock is 7 for the first, then changed to 11 before the second. Each runs:

```ts
const result = await assistant.generateText(ctx, { threadId }, { prompt: "Check stock" });
```
questions.question: Alongside the user messages and final replies, what does the component persist?

options.text: The two tool calls, but neither returned stock value.
options.rationale: Default Agent storage includes tool result messages as well as assistant tool-call messages.

options.text: The returned stock values 7 and 11, but neither tool name nor arguments.
options.rationale: The stored assistant tool-call messages retain the invoked tool name and arguments.

options.text: Neither the tool calls nor results; only the final assistant text is stored.
options.rationale: Intermediate tool steps are stored by default; disabling storage is an explicit separate option.

options.text: Both tool calls and their corresponding results, 7 and 11.
options.rationale: Real SDK execution records assistant tool-call messages and tool-result messages for both runs.
